name: meshy
description: Generate, texture, rig, animate and 3D-print models with Meshy AI through Meshy's first-party MCP server (pinned @meshy-ai/meshy-mcp-server@0.6.5 over npx stdio), with a meshy-3d workflow skill bundled. Credit-spending calls ask for approval first. In Hermes Desktop: inline three.js 3D cards, a model gallery and a credit chip.

api_key.label: Meshy API key
api_key.description: Create one at meshy.ai/developers/keys (any paid Meshy plan). Saving it restarts the Meshy tools with the new key.

show_credits.label: Credit balance in the status bar
show_credits.description: Desktop: show remaining Meshy credits in the status bar.

inline_viewer.label: Inline 3D cards in chat
inline_viewer.description: Desktop: render ::meshy-model replies as interactive 3D cards. Off shows them as text.

auto_rotate.label: Auto-rotate in the gallery
auto_rotate.description: Desktop: slowly spin the model in the gallery viewer.

gallery_limit.label: Recent generations shown
gallery_limit.description: How many recent Meshy generations the gallery lists (1-60).

blender_handoff.label: Blender optimized copy
blender_handoff.description: When Blender is installed, offer an optimized copy for game testing after a download (packed textures, optional triangle budget, new .blend + GLB/FBX). Runs locally, no additional Meshy credits. Ask offers it once.

default_detail.label: Default detail level
default_detail.description: How the Meshy skill picks mesh detail when you do not say. Ask asks what the asset is and where it goes; game uses Smart Topology sized per asset (characters ~15k, weapons ~3k, props ~1.5k triangles); mobile halves those; detailed uses Standard full detail (renders, close-ups, printing).

blender_path.label: Blender executable
blender_path.description: Full path to Blender 4.2 or newer. Empty finds it on PATH or in the usual install folders.
